title: Disavow list
dek: A private warning list for members with a documented track record of harming others. Decided by Dread Pizza Roberts.
banner: This list is private. Never share it, screenshot it, or repeat it outside the app. Only factual claims backed by first-hand knowledge or evidence belong here. Every view is logged. Entries expire after 12 months unless re-confirmed.

form.title: Nominate someone
form.intro: Dread Pizza Roberts vote before anything becomes visible. The person is not told about a nomination.
form.searchHelp: Search by name or member ID. Picking a member adds the handles we know for them.
form.name: Name they go by
form.statementHelp: What happened, when, amounts, links. No opinions about character. 20 to 1500 characters.
form.evidenceHelp: Up to 5 https links, one per line.
form.attest: This is accurate to my knowledge and I have first-hand knowledge or evidence.
form.errorGeneric: Could not submit. Check the form and try again.
form.errorDuplicate: This person is already nominated or listed.
form.errorLimit: You have reached the nomination limit for now.
form.errorRate: Too many requests. Try again shortly.

detail.redacted: Parts of this entry were redacted.

vote.title: DPR vote
vote.rule: Needs at least 3 yes and more yes than no. Decided from day 7; closes {date}.

response.title: Your listing
response.intro: You are on the disavow list. This is what is recorded. Your response appears beside it for members who can see the list.
response.label: Your response
response.appealHelp: Asks Dread Pizza Roberts to vote on removing the listing. You can appeal once every 90 days.
response.appealed: Appeal filed. Dread Pizza Roberts will vote.
response.tooSoon: You can appeal once every 90 days.

vouch.title: Disavow list warning
vouch.body: This person is on the disavow list. Do not share this outside the app. Vouch anyway?
